roadmap.name: Accounting Principles
roadmap.description: Understand the fundamental principles of accounting, including GAAP and IFRS.

roadmap.name: Financial Statement Analysis
roadmap.description: Analyze financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) to assess a company's financial health.

roadmap.name: Tax Compliance
roadmap.description: Learn the rules and regulations for tax filing and compliance.

roadmap.name: Excel Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Master basic Excel functions for data manipulation and analysis.

roadmap.name: Data Entry
roadmap.description: Efficiently and accurately input data into accounting systems.

roadmap.name: Pass Entry-Level Exam
roadmap.description: Successfully pass a recognized entry-level accounting exam (e.g., CPA Fundamentals).

goals.name: Have more endurance
current_quests: Go for a run once a week

roadmap.name: Zone 2 Base Building
roadmap.description: Develop a sustainable aerobic base through consistent Zone 2 cardio training. Focus on maintaining a conversational pace and building mitochondrial efficiency.

roadmap.name: Form Running Mechanics
roadmap.description: Improve running form to maximize efficiency and reduce injury risk. Includes drills for posture, stride length, and cadence.

roadmap.name: Mobility and Flexibility
roadmap.description: Increase range of motion and joint flexibility to support movement and prevent injury. Incorporate dynamic and static stretching.

roadmap.name: Lactate Threshold Training
roadmap.description: Increase the lactate threshold through interval training at a pace just below maximal effort. This improves the body's ability to clear lactate and sustain higher intensities.

roadmap.name: Run 5K in 25 Minutes
roadmap.description: Achieve a 5K time of 25 minutes or less through a structured training plan incorporating Zone 2, lactate threshold, and speed work.

goals.name: Be more in tune with myself

roadmap.name: Daily Self-Reflection Protocol
roadmap.description: Establish a consistent daily practice of examining your thoughts, feelings, and behaviors to gain self-awareness.

roadmap.name: Values Alignment Assessment
roadmap.description: Identify your core values and evaluate how your current actions align with them. This involves introspection and honest evaluation.

roadmap.name: Emotional Regulation Practice
roadmap.description: Develop techniques for managing and responding to challenging emotions in a healthy and constructive way. Includes mindfulness and cognitive reframing.

roadmap.name: Mindfulness Meditation Practice
roadmap.description: Engage in regular meditation to cultivate present moment awareness and reduce reactivity.

roadmap.name: Establish Daily Mental Hygiene Routine
roadmap.description: Create and consistently implement a daily routine incorporating self-reflection, mindfulness, and emotional regulation techniques to support mental wellbeing.

goals.name: Be able to talk to more people

roadmap.name: Open-Ended Conversation Starters
roadmap.description: Learn and practice simple, open-ended questions to initiate conversations with strangers. Examples: 'What brings you here today?', 'What are you working on lately?'

roadmap.name: Active Listening Techniques
roadmap.description: Develop skills in active listening: paraphrasing, summarizing, asking clarifying questions, and demonstrating genuine interest in what the other person is saying.

roadmap.name: Social Perceptiveness - Reading Cues
roadmap.description: Learn to observe and interpret nonverbal cues (body language, facial expressions) to understand how others are feeling and responding.

roadmap.name: Rapport Building - Finding Common Ground
roadmap.description: Identify shared interests and experiences to establish a connection with others. Focus on building a sense of trust and mutual understanding.

roadmap.name: Sharing Personal Experiences (Appropriately)
roadmap.description: Gradually share appropriate personal anecdotes to foster a deeper connection. Start with low-stakes stories and gauge the other person's receptiveness.

roadmap.name: Attend 3 Meetups and Initiate 5 Conversations
roadmap.description: Attend three social events (meetups, workshops, etc.) and actively initiate conversations with at least five different people, focusing on building rapport and asking open-ended questions.
